## Search Bar for Test Suites


Our team has added a new search bar to the home page, making it easier to quickly find specific test suites. It also includes additional filtering options to help you narrow down your results:


- **Type of testing:** Desktop web, Mobile web, etc.
- **Search scope:** Current folder or All folders
